profiles.subtitle: What is applied automatically to each game.

profiles.empty.title: No profiles yet

profiles.conflict.title: The profiles file changed while you were editing
profiles.conflict.body: Another client or a manual edit modified it. It is never overwritten without you choosing.
profiles.outside.merged: {process} was changed outside this window. Your changes are kept; fields you had not touched now show the saved version.
profiles.outside.conflicts: Some fields were changed here and outside. Choose which version to keep.
profiles.outside.removed: {process} was removed outside this window. Saving creates it again with these values.
profiles.editor.rule_hint_exact: Ignores case and spaces at the start and end.
profiles.editor.rule_hint_regex: Searches anywhere in the title; use ^…$ to match the whole title.
profiles.editor.rule_locked: The window rule of an existing profile cannot change. Create another profile and delete this one.
profiles.editor.island_overrides: The island overrides the monitor and the offsets
profiles.editor.resolution_help: Game resolution in physical pixels; leave it empty if you don't know it.
profiles.error.process_excluded: This process is excluded and is never modified
profiles.error.process_duplicate: A profile for this process already exists
profiles.error.rule_required: Enter the window title or the expression
profiles.error.rule_duplicate: A profile for this process and rule already exists
profiles.error.rule_conflict: This profile has both an exact title and a regular expression, which is not allowed. Delete it and create it again with one rule.
profiles.error.resolution_pair: Give both width and height, or leave both empty
profiles.warning.island_overrides_monito: {process}: the island overrides the monitor and the offsets; remove one of the two.
profiles.warning.bad_island_ref: {process}: the island "{island}" is not in the layout/island format.
profiles.warning.island_not_found: {process}: the island "{island}" does not exist in any layout.
profiles.warning.bad_game_resolution: {process}: the game resolution must be greater than 0.
profiles.warning.game_resolution_exceeds: {process}: the game resolution does not fit in the island and will be cropped.
profiles.warning.bad_layout_id: The layout "{layout}" has an empty identifier or one with "/".
profiles.warning.bad_island_id: The island "{island}" of the layout "{layout}" has an empty identifier or one with "/".
profiles.warning.duplicate_island: The island "{island}" is duplicated in the layout "{layout}".
profiles.warning.bad_island_rect: The island "{island}" of the layout "{layout}" has an invalid rectangle.
profiles.warning.bad_title: {process}: the exact title is empty; enter the window title or use any window.
profiles.warning.bad_title_regex: {process}: the title regular expression is empty or not valid.
profiles.warning.title_rule_conflict: {process}: a profile can have an exact title or a regular expression, not both.
profiles.warning.duplicate_profile: {process}: more than one profile has this process and rule; only the first one is used.
